title: One JSON log line of a tool of PodUtils
description: One object on each line. The classes and their exit codes are the table of crates/pod-core/README.md.

schema.description: The version of the schema, as in each schema of schemas/: pod_core::LOG_SCHEMA

event.description: a dotted name, for example relay.session.open

fields.description: the values of the event; never a secret

stage.description: the name of pod_core::Stage of a failure

class.description: the name of pod_core::Class of a failure
